summary: Temporary crow's nest on Winchester Peak in Pend Oreille County, WA, recorded in 1940 and abandoned in the 1940s; sources disagree on the national forest.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1940s; no source we read says what, if anything, remains at the site.

events.note: First record: a crow's nest, described as temporary; no build date given
Abandoned in the 1940s; the sources give no exact year

evidence.supports: firelookout.com gives agency as Colville National Forest

evidence.quote: In 1940, there was a crow's nest. It was abandoned in the 1940s.

evidence.supports: WillhiteWeb calls it a temporary site; no maps it found show it
evidence.quote: No maps found show this temporary site.

evidence.supports: listed as Crowsnest type, Abandoned status
evidence.quote: Winchester Peak Pend Oreille 48.32826 -117.41575 Crowsnest Abandoned

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts gives agency as Kaniksu National Forest

corrections.why: The sources say the crow's nest was abandoned in the 1940s. None of the pages we read says it was removed or destroyed.

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on the national forest: firelookout.com says Colville, while the Forest Lookouts page and the record say Kaniksu, so agency is left out of facts. Record coordinates: firelookout.org's list gives 48.32826, -117.41575 (the record's ffla value). The record's west_us_lookouts value 48.3305, -117.4034 appears on none of the pages read. The record's status 'gone' is not supported; sources say abandoned in the 1940s. No photo found. Confidence is low because each source is one or two lines.
